overview: Poly is an abused pony who has become recalcitrant through bullying. He belongs to the menagerie of a traveling circus which, at the beginning of the story, is set up in Saint-Cyr-sur-Dourdan, where little Pascal lives. He is then 4 years old and comes to observe the preparations for the show he plans to attend that evening. He wanders near the caravans, opening his eyes sometimes curious, sometimes admiring, when suddenly, tragedy strikes, he sees a little defenseless pony mistreated by unscrupulous torturers. Then, an idea comes to him, to allow the pony to escape! He succeeds and helps him hide, aided by the children of the village who build him a shelter, heal him and feed him. Pascal will then live with his pony a great story of friendship full of adventure.
title: Poly

overview: The sentimental education of a 16-year-old young man in Montmartre in the 1970s, his difficult beginnings in professional life, his stormy love affair with the lovely Isabelle and his quarrels with his father, a genius but alcoholic painter.

overview: The romance of two children brought together in the same universe by a shared fate. Paul is the natural son of Marguerite, the daughter of Breton peasants, abused by a gentleman and forced to hide her sin "in the colonies." Virginie is the daughter of Madame de La Tour, whom her husband, "who died of pestilential fevers," leaves a widow and soon-to-be mother on the shores of a remote island in the Indian Ocean.

Shen Wenqian decides to use the girl and enters into a fictitious marriage with her, thereby avoiding the marriage with the minister's daughter. Three years pass, and Yu Yanxing is still looking for an opportunity to escape from the golden cage.

After a difficult decade, which included a stay in the Federal Witness Protection Program, McDeere and his family now emerge from isolation to reclaim their lives and their future -- only to find that past dangers are still lurking and new threats are everywhere.

overview: What is it like to be poor in one of the world's richest – and most equal – countries? Thomas Seltzer delves into poverty-stricken Norway.
title: Seltzer: Den norske fattigdommen

overview: Sigurdur Thordarson, known as Siggi, becomes a hacker at 12, exposing Icelandic bank corruption at 14. Branded the "teenage whistleblower," he joins WikiLeaks in 2010, mentored by Julian Assange. Siggi leaks globally, but clashes with Assange, prompting him to spy for the FBI at 18. This tale weaves paranoia, hacking, and friendship, portraying Siggi's turbulent journey from trust to betrayal, revealing a heart-wrenching coming-of-age narrative.
title: A Dangerous Boy

overview: On January 15, 2004, the Bugaled Breizh, a Breton trawler, sinks off the English coast, killing its 5 sailors. Marie, sister-in-law of one, links the sinking to NATO military exercises. and risks everything to uncover the truth.

overview: The genius Lin Zhixia is straightforward and reserved, never ever having a close friend. Admitted to Provincial No. 1 Middle School, she meets the sunny top student Jiang Yubai in a problem-solving competition and becomes his desk mate. As a social butterfly, Jiang helps Lin fit in, making friends like Tang Tingting, Duan Qiyan, Shen Fuxuan, and Jin Baihui. In return, Lin helps him with his studies. Starting off as competitors, they grow to support one another and become the best of friends. Together, they assist a classmate being scammed, and participate in club activities and the provincial math competition. Though he catches feelings for her, he keeps them hidden. After Lin is recommended to Fudan University, Jiang plans to confess to her during the graduation trip. Unfortunately, he has to leave because his mother is involved in a fraud case. Amid the obstacles, will the two find their way back to each other?
title: Genius Girlfriend

overview: Bus-driver-turned-Cocaine-King. Jesus Ruiz Henao flooded '90s Britain with cocaine, building a billion-pound empire. It took police five years to convict him, in what would become the largest surveillance operation of its kind.
title: The Bus Driver: Britain's Cocaine King

overview: Capital (پایتخت‎‎ Paytakht) is an Iranian TV Series about a family from a county are planning to migrate to Tehran but upon arrival in Tehran which coincided with the Norouz and they are encountered with problems that cause strange events.

overview: Wake up to reliable reporting that delivers the essential facts you need to start your day informed, along with expert commentary and thoughtful analysis. Get an early look at the top stories shaping national and global conversations. Whether it's politics, business, culture, or breaking news, you'll be prepared for whatever the day brings.
title: Wake Up America Early

overview: Quick fire sketch show starring top impressionists of the day including Peter Goodwright, Freddie Starr and Janet Brown.

overview: Comedian, actor and artist Johnny Vegas is to embark on his most personal project in an artistic love letter to his hometown. Johnny Vegas: Art, ADHD & Me will see one of Britain's best loved entertainers and trained potters take on the biggest artistic challenge of his career: to create a piece of public art for St. Helens in Merseyside. What starts as a creative endeavour turns into a journey of self-discovery when Johnny receives a diagnosis of ADHD. Though the original artistic vision falters, the documentary uncovers a silver lining—an honest and heartfelt conversation about mental health and understanding yourself.
title: Johnny Vegas: Art, ADHD & Me

overview: Dating apps, the greatest and most evil invention of this century, can attract marriage with a finger, and can also destroy a marriage with a finger. Three unit stories, three groups of men and women, who developed a relationship called F buddies because of the dating apps.

Navigating a whirlpool of brotherhood, greed, fraud, true feelings, justice, and evil, he delves deeper and uncovers the dark truths buried within the island's shadows.
title: Under the Cover

overview: The series will see a different Welsh celebrity face the sharp spotlight of the interviewers in each episode. While they may be used to media interviews, nothing will have prepared them for the honesty and unique perspectives of Y Cyfweliad.
title: Y Cyfweliad

overview: In each episode of this unique entertainment series, one of Canada's most popular celebrities and public figures faces a group of 30 atypical neurodivergent interviewers, where no topic or question is off-limits. The Assembly is a global sensation that delivers profound revelation, authentic conversations, and a lot of laughs.
title: The Assembly

overview: The Orient Express: A Golden Era of Travel – a 4 x 60' series set to launch on More4 in September – will take viewers on the epic 1,700-mile journey from London to Istanbul. The series will travel along the route and stop at key cities and towns including Munich, Salzburg, Vienna, Budapest and Sofia – exploring how they each played an exciting role in passengers' journeys on the Orient Express. In its golden era, the train was a second home for celebrities, politicians, monarchs and spies – as well as a notable inspiration for author, Agatha Christie – and the series will explore the history of the route and chart how Europe has changed since the Orient Express launched in 1883. As well as the glory days of the past, the series examines how war and political upheaval shaped and impacted the cross-country train service that connected countries across the continent for decades. Comparing then and now, The Orient Express: A Golden Era of Travel will also feature the inaugural run of Golden Eagle's luxury train service from Paris to Istanbul – highlighting how the lavish rail travel pioneered by the Orient Express in the 19th and 20th centuries continues to this day.
title: The Orient Express: A Golden Era of Travel

overview: Twenty-five athletes, most retired, compete to win 30M yen to launch their second career. Can they overcome tough physical and psychological challenges?
title: Final Draft

overview: Could you live off bargain store products alone? Denise Van Outen leads this bold consumer experiment, as proudly picky families swap their supermarket go-tos for discount store alternatives.
title: The Big Pound Shop Swap

overview: The daughter of reality royalty turns 18! Follow Princess as she celebrates her milestone birthday & carves her own path – away from her famous folks, Katie Price & Peter Andre.
title: The Princess Diaries

overview: The dark side of self-improvement. With testimony from users, gang members and those who caught them, this is how a father and son from north Wales built an illegal steroid empire.
title: Confessions of a Steroid Gang

overview: Bryan Dobson and Dearbhail McDonald chart the unique evolution of the Irish missionary movement.
title: The Last Irish Missionaries

overview: For seven decades after its tragic sinking, the Titanic lay undiscovered on the ocean floor. This compelling series tracks the search for the wreck across the depths of the Atlantic.
title: Titanic: Secrets of the Shipwreck

overview: Kang Jae is a wealthy businessman and gangster and Mi Joo is a plastic surgeon. These two meet after Mi Joo mistakes Kang Jae as being her sleazy brother-in-law. Kang Jae just happens to be the boyfriend of Mi Joo's pregnant neighbour, Yoo Jin. Sae Yeon meets Mi Joo and falls in love with her feisty attitude. Kang Jae works for the father of Sae Yeon who is a gangster. Mi Joo and Kang Jae fall in love.
title: Lovers

overview: A French remake of the British crime drama Broadchurch, set in Corsica.
title: Malaterra

overview: Alice is devastated when her best friend Steve starts dating her 26-year-old daughter Izzy. She's going to lose her best friend and her daughter in one fell swoop. Alice tries everything she can to end the relationship. Unfortunately for her, Steve's more than ready for the attack, and what begins as a perfect friendship, devolves into an all-out feud. A hilarious, messy, and complicated exploration of friendship, family, and love, Alice and Steve is an anti-romantic comedy that asks the question, how far would you go for love - or revenge? Will Alice forgive Steve? Will Steve and Izzy make a relationship work? Amongst all the questions hanging in the balance, one thing is certain; their lives will never be the same again.
title: Alice and Steve
Fu Ren Ta Zhuan Zhi Bu Fu
Xi Tong Bi Wo Tie Tie Bing Jiao Fu Jun

overview: Fifteen years after the mysterious death of housekeeper Chen Ruyi, Yue Yan—the girl Chen once saved—secretly infiltrates the powerful Gu family to exact revenge. As she gathers evidence, she uncovers a dark international organ trafficking conspiracy and discovers that the seemingly reckless Gu family second young master hides a secretive identity of his own.
title: Autumn Scenery

overview: Qiao Yan's life is turned upside down when her parents are suddenly killed in a car accident. Overnight, she goes from being their beloved little princess to a lonely orphan. Soon after, Gu Changfeng, the chairman of the Gu Corporation and a man claiming to be her biological grandfather, appears and insists on bringing her back to China. Though reluctant to return to the Gu family, Qiao Yan is troubled by the many suspicious details surrounding her parents' deaths. Determined to uncover the truth, she agrees to go back and begins to approach her so-called "uncle," Gu Jingyuan, the adopted son of the Gu patriarch. At the Gu household, she plays the part of a meek and pitiful orphan, trying to win over Gu Jingyuan. But he remains cold and indifferent, unmoved by her act. A hidden battle begins between the two, each equally matched in wit and will. Just as Qiao Yan becomes convinced that Gu Jingyuan is the one behind her parents' murder, he risks his life to save her from a raging fire, and confesses his desire to protect both her and the Gu family. Shaken, Qiao Yan begins to understand his pain, and in that understanding, falls deeply in love with him. Their forbidden love weathers countless trials. But just as they finally decide to defy Gu patriarch's opposition and walk into marriage with open hearts, a far greater conspiracy crashes down upon them. To protect each other, they are forced to hide their true feelings, caught in a storm of searing love and bitter suffering. Amidst the chaos, they use their own flesh and blood to shield each other from the oncoming storm.
title: Fall in You

overview: The series follows the lives of Naná and Gegê, a pair of con artists. Gegê is Tina Pepper's uncle, a Tina Turner fan who dreams of becoming a famous singer.
title: Cambalacho

overview: A non-traditional widower for the 1950s, Álvaro has an open relationship with his daughters and becomes the target of criticism from his sister-in-law Fausta, especially when he meets Marta.
title: Bambolê
Bu Yuan Liang, Bu Fu Hun! Ta Ling Pan Gao Zhi

overview: In a fishing village, Grandma Manuela, endowed with mystical powers, seals the body of her grandson, Nô, from love. But Eduarda's arrival completely changes the boy's destiny.
title: Riacho Doce

overview: The Haunted Hathaways follows the adventures of a not-so-typical blended family. When Michelle Hathaway relocates to New Orleans, LA., to open a bakery with her daughters Taylor and Frankie, they quickly learn that life in the "Big Easy" is very different. Unbeknownst to them, their new home is already occupied by a ghost family comprised of jazz musician father Ray Preston, and his sons Miles and Louie. After agreeing to live under one roof, they come to care about and rely on one another while driving each other crazy -- just like any normal family would. Though leery at first, the Hathaways soon discover how much fun life can be when living with ghosts.
title: The Haunted Hathaways

overview: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza follows a very scared man as he navigates a barrage of absurd, terrifying, and hilarious dreamscapes.
title: The Terrors of Jordan Mendoza

overview: Hand trowels or tea towels? Countertops or treetops? Architect George Clarke and garden designer Luke Millard help families choose between their kitchen and garden renovations..
title: George Clarke's Kitchen vs Garden

overview: They're an elite fighting unit like no other - steeped in tradition, primed for battle, and ready to die for King and Country. If Britain goes to war in Eastern Europe, the brave men and women of The Royal Welsh will be on the frontline, laying down their lives to protect our cherished freedoms. This series offers unprecedented access to the Royal Welsh, one of Britain's most decorated armoured infantry units, as they live together and train in their Warrior armoured vehicles, ready to be called up at a moment's notice to join a war in eastern Europe and beyond. When the going gets tough, these Welsh Warriors are the guys you call. For six months, our cameras follow the 1st Battalion Royal Welsh as they live, work and train, preparing for a war that looks likelier every day. We follow every trial, every tradition, and every triumph, and witness the pride and the honour of serving in this incredible Welsh regiment.
title: Soldier: For King and Country

overview: Of course we wouldn't let you miss her. The little princess of Brazil, Chanel, came back home with all her luggage unpacked and wishing for gossip! Hosting the eliminated queens of Drag Race Brasil season 2, the contestants will show everything they presented on the runway and a sneak peek of what they didn't have the chance to display.
title: Mostra a Mala

overview: Nick Knowles returns to 5 for a truly spectacular adventure, this time in the most desolate place on earth - the Gobi Desert. At five times the size of the UK, with the smallest population on earth, Mongolia is vast and remote and the stunning wilderness of the Gobi covers a third of the country. As Nick discovers, the land of Genghis Kahn and dinosaurs is not only steeped in rich traditions but is also home to some of the most warm-hearted people in the world. From a horse academy keeping alive the remarkable horseback archery skills of the Kahn's warrior hoard to a bout of Mongolian wrestling, followed by a visit to a shaman, this adventure both moved and fascinated Nick beyond expectation.
title: Lost in the Desert with Nick Knowles

overview: Taste of Russia is unique. It's not a cooking show; it's not a travel show: it's both! Over 190 nationalities live Russia, each with their own unique cultures and food traditions. Join two friends, Russian actor Oscar Kuchera and American foodie Glen Kutsovsky, as they explore the world's biggest country through the vast diversity of its cuisine. Along the way, they learn to prepare traditional Russian dishes while delving into their history.
title: Taste of Russia

overview: In 2013, RT became the first news channel to receive more than 1 billion views on YouTube, confirming its status as the world's biggest news content provider. ‘News Team' shows how the channel's news mechanism operates through the lens of its correspondents' work.
title: News Team

overview: Two teams of comics are tested on their - knowledge of comedy trivia - as well as getting plenty of opportunities to out-gag each other.
title: Gag Tag

overview: Far away in the deep reaches of space lies the Beta Star on where magical human-like people live. Comet is one of those people who is a student in a school in the Beta Star. But one day, she made an accident in the school, causing the principal to get angry at her and banish her to Earth in hopes it can teach her to be responsible for her actions. In Earth, she made her residence with both the Kawagoe and Ishihara families as she uses her magic to solve some problems with a little guidance.
title: Comet-san

overview: Comet, a soon-to-be graduate of the Star School on Planet Virgo, arrives on Earth via UFO with the task of finding the most beautiful thing on the planet as a graduation exam. She is taken in by the Sawano family, working as a housekeeper and gets into various high jinks with the use of her Magic Baton. Receiving guidance and encouragement from her Star Mother above, Comet finds the true beauty on Earth within her various experiences of love through human contact.
title: Comet-san

overview: We seem to spend most of our lives online. We work, shop, learn, talk to friends, upload, download, share and like all day long! Almost everything we do is online. It's often convenient and can even be fun, but all that digital technology comes at a price. You might be surprised to know how easily you could be hacked. Learn how to stay safe online and avoid falling victim to cybercrime with RT Documentary's latest series. Do you know the rules of digital hygiene? Find out about the many types of cybercrime and the latest developments in the digital world: ‘I am Hacked'.
title: I am Hacked

overview: The series begins when the body of teenage figure skater Sophie Madsen is discovered, sending shockwaves through the town of Wakestead. As DI Crane and DI Radley dig deeper, what starts as a tragic death, spirals into a tangled web of lies, institutional cover-ups, and moral compromise. As the clock ticks and trust fractures, Crane must navigate both a murder investigation and the treacherous politics inside her own team.
title: The Blame

overview: Alexandre attempts to rob the safe at his office to pay off a debt and is arrested. In prison, he decides to take his own life and begins to torment all those he holds responsible for his fate.
title: A Viagem

overview: Estrellita is a young, poor peasant girl. Her mother is very ill, so she goes to Buenos Aires. Before she dies, Estrellita's mother makes the girl's father promise that he will take care of her when she is left alone in the world. Estrellita's mother dies, and the man, manipulated by his sophisticated wife, takes her to work in his mansion as a servant. There, Estrellita meets Juano, a sad man married to a woman he doesn't love, and who is only with her because he feels guilty about her disability. Estrellita and Juanjo fall in love, and she becomes pregnant. Many will try to separate them, but their love is greater than all.
title: Estrellita mía

overview: American actor and showman Glen Kutsovsky travels around Russia in search of adventure and thrills. He meets the strongest people, interviews them and tries to uncover the secrets of their superpowers.
title: Самые сильные

overview: Leaving behind their homes in Indonesia, four women form an unlikely friendship and face eccentric dilemmas as they navigate life in New York.
title: Ratu Ratu Queens: The Series

overview: Home chefs attempt to recreate their mother's famous recipe to see if their version stacks up against mama's original dish.
title: Not Like Mama

overview: In The Floor, 81 quiz fanatics face off in quiz duels on a giant LED floor divided into 81 equal squares, each representing its own field of knowledge. The goal is to conquer the entire floor and take home a huge cash prize. The rules are simple. A random contestant challenges an adjoining opponent in a quiz duel. They play against each other in the category of the opponent's square. Categories range from 'famous athletes' to 'Hollywood actors' and from ‘iconic buildings' to 'mammals'. Some questions are visually supported by photographs, others by sound, while other duels focus on open questions, multiple choice, association: the possibilities are endless. The winner of a duel conquers his opponent's square, gaining more ground - the loser leaves the game. The further the game progresses, the more exciting the duels become and the higher the stakes. After ten episodes, who will be the last person standing on The Floor and take home the impressive cash prize?
title: The Floor
